Amanuensis

Codebase

Use it when you are changing something two subsystems share.

Terms on this page

Concern
One kind of defect worth looking for in this codebase, such as a race on a shared cache. The review checklist is the full list.
System boundary
A place where two subsystems share something (a table, a queue, a cache) and depend on each other's assumptions about it.

SM-D02-P02

Kind
table
Parties
D-02 ↔ P-02
Assessment ready
✅

Shared object

memory.db tables and the standing-reconciliation predicate, read by dev/check-store-fully-surveyed.mjs

Notes

The checker issues each clause's queries separately with no explicit read transaction, so a server writing concurrently could make clauses read different states. Any SQL error is turned into an empty result by rows(), so a renamed column reads as no rows; the required-table check at lines 108-116 is the only schema-version guard.

SM-D02-R01

Kind
table
Parties
D-02 ↔ R-01
Assessment ready
✅

Shared object

scope_rules, scope_sorting, scope_mode_changes and scope_exclusions, with the scope and exclusion digests and the glob matcher

Notes

The checker does not normalize patterns; it relies on tools/scope.ts normalizing them before they are stored. It needs no include/exclude precedence, because it reads the exclusions a reconciliation already resolved. Gate SC5 case P4 compares the restated matcher with the server's over a 9-pattern corpus.
